news.title: 1 in 3 international students stay in Germany until retirement
news.summary_en: Germany’s 2023 international student cohort could generate a €23.1 billion surplus for public finances but experts say stronger pathways into employment remain essential.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Canada: Calls for probe after CBSA officials target student protesters
news.summary_en: Over 250 organisations are demanding an investigation into federal immigration officers who issued removal orders to international graduates protesting in Calgary, Alberta.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: EAIE president urges sector to face uncertainty and seize Erasmus reset
news.summary_en: Stakeholders gathering in Glasgow were urged to embrace “revolution”, confront rising uncertainty, and seize a “genuine reason for hope” as the UK and Switzerland prepare to rejoin Erasmus+.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Catriona Olsen, King’s InterHigh
news.summary_en: This week, The PIE sat down with Catriona Olsen, the executive head of the DfE-accredited online school King’s InterHigh. We spoke about the school's new mentorship program and why the future of education is online.
news.author: The PIE News team

news.title: Studyportals and Made Impact partner to showcase personal international education stories
news.summary_en: Studyportals and Made Impact have partnered to launch a global platform designed to collect and amplify stories demonstrating the impact of international education and student mobility.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Universities Australia calls for student concessions as living costs soar
news.summary_en: Universities Australia has called on the Albanese government to extend concession cards to all domestic university students and provide international students with equal access to public transport discounts, as rising living costs put increasing pressure on students.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Judge signals possible halt to US student visa duration rule
news.summary_en: A US federal judge is weighing a landmark court challenge to the government’s proposed end to duration of status after a Boston hearing last week.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: New Zealand international education export earnings hit $4.98bn
news.summary_en: New Zealand’s international education sector has pushed export earnings to NZ$4.98 billion, surpassing its pre-pandemic value and putting the government’s longer-term growth target within clearer reach.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: UpGrad completes Unacademy acquisition at $206m valuation
news.summary_en: The all-stock deal combines Unacademy’s online test-preparation and consumer-learning businesses with upGrad’s higher education and upskilling portfolio.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Worsening ELT declines signal market “restructuring”
news.summary_en: A second consecutive year of global English language teaching (ELT) declines mark the emergence of a new sector structure, say experts.
news.author: Polly Nash
